guardText: The implemented slice is local, devnet-only, disabled by default, non-custodial, and audit-only. Hosted evidence fails closed; MCP audit delivery fails open without changing the downstream result.
No signing, submission, delegation, simulation, authorization, Solana RPC, base-layer effect, checkpoint, trust-anchor, registry, key/custody, or production activation is included.
The strategic checkpoint and registry remain future and blocked.

tasks.title: Implement the local MagicBlock devnet evidence-and-audit preflight
acceptanceCriteria: The producer accepts only a closed opaque internal-candidate reference, resolves through an injected immutable source, validates devnet/canonical public keys/closed fields, persists the candidate and decoded-plan bindings through an injected immutable store, and returns only an opaque trusted-plan reference.
Resolution recomputes candidate, decoded-plan, every account digest, and every security flag before evidence is used.
The disabled-by-default injected adapter makes zero calls while disabled and, when enabled, can POST only to https://devnet-router.magicblock.app/ with getDelegationStatus and redirects rejected.
The transport receives a mandatory 16384-byte streaming cap; the adapter rechecks UTF-8 bytes and enforces fixed parser depth/token limits before duplicate-safe closed JSON parsing.

Each call uses the official params array containing exactly one base58 account string and an integer request ID derived from a unique evaluation; Compass candidate IDs and digests never enter the wire payload, and the response must echo the integer ID.

Each result requires boolean isDelegated, accepts only documented optional fqdn and official authority/owner/delegationSlot/lamports metadata, and rejects the former Compass-specific object parameter and delegationRecord envelope.

The injected append-only ledger atomically persists only a private deep-frozen closed/redacted snapshot and digest, then returns only auditEventId and attestationDigest; caller mutation after validation cannot affect materialization.

The writer derives review_required/confirmed only from all-delegated evidence and incompatible/incompatible only when any account is base_layer; callers cannot supply outcome/rationale and unavailable never creates an audit.
The integration returns only review_required, incompatible, or unavailable audit outcomes and has no authorization/execution import or input.

AST-based dependency closure treats all ten runtime modules as roots, traverses the full local closure from every protected boundary, rejects direct or transitive protected parse/CommonJS/unresolved/nonliteral/out-of-root imports, bidirectional and sibling-bridge protected reachability, external feature dependencies, non-crypto builtins, direct network/process capabilities, and feature local imports outside source roots without failing on ordinary unrelated bare packages.
Focused runtime and guard tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement the disabled-by-default MagicBlock hosted audit runtime foundation
acceptanceCriteria: A closed request accepts only an opaque observation ID and canonical base64 unsigned Solana v0 transaction; the trusted decoder rejects signed, legacy, ALT, malformed, trailing, or empty-instruction transactions and derives all account flags internally.
Candidate source and trusted-plan persistence are immutable and request-scoped.

The only concrete network capability is a literal MagicBlock devnet Router transport with redirects rejected, a 16384-byte streaming cap, a two-second per-call timeout, an eight-second ingress deadline, at most eight accounts, and concurrency four under a 15-second hosted duration.

Postgres observation idempotency, bounded stale-claim recovery with immutable claim-attempt fencing, causally ordered singleton-tip advance plus SHA-256 append plus observation completion guarded to exactly one transition each, missing-tip rollback/recovery, and commit-ambiguity reconciliation reuse COMPASS_VERDICT_DB_URL without an enabled-mode in-memory fallback.
The separately authenticated Next audit entrypoint is disabled by default; only the five explicitly named ingress modules may consume feature roots, and transitive dependencies receive no privilege.
Policy, execution, confirmation, signer, sender, delegation, and MCP dispatcher closures remain isolated.
Focused unit, Postgres integration, closure, and entrypoint tests pass without live endpoint calls.

tasks.title: Implement the one-way MagicBlock MCP audit observer
acceptanceCriteria: The real createProxyMcpServerHandlers().callTool boundary extracts only from an allowed actual downstream non-error result after downstream completion, passes a detached frozen closed observation rather than the result to the sink, and returns the exact original result reference and state unchanged.

The closed extractor inspects only structuredContent at its root and accepts only the exact Wave 14A observation schema with strict identifier, exact-key, decoded-size, canonical base64, and zero-unused-padding-bit bounds.

The independently authenticated hosted audit client accepts only a canonical HTTPS DNS audit-route URL, rejects redirects and URL ambiguity, bounds payload before transport, enforces at most a one-second timeout even if transport ignores abort, and never reads or returns hosted response data for policy or control flow.
Missing or invalid optional observer configuration remains disabled and never falls back to ingress or general hosted credentials.

Observer synchronous throw, rejection, late rejection, timeout, HTTP rejection, wrong authentication, malformed content, and mutation attempts are fail-open and cannot change MCP deep equality, object identity, policy, approval, execution, signing, sending, or delegation behavior.

Focused entrypoint tests cover off/on, success/failure, malformed/irrelevant/extra-key/oversized/noncanonical-base64 content, auth, timeout, payload bounds, detached immutability, exact identity/state, and denied/error exclusion.

A no-live-service E2E crosses linked MCP SDK transports, createProxyMcpServer request wiring, the real dispatcher, a fake DownstreamMcpClient, injected hosted-audit and MagicBlock transports, hosted ingress, and PGlite-compatible persistence without injecting a post-dispatch proxy result.

The dependency verifier enforces exact local edges, external import sets, counted AST-use policies for required globals, and an exact per-role table for every computed member access in each of seven observer/server modules; because those modules require no binding patterns, it rejects every BindingElement and object/array destructuring assignment or loop target, including aliased, shorthand, nested, parameter, string-literal, computed-name, defaulted constructor/__proto__ extraction. It also rejects all unrecognized computed access, CommonJS, createRequire, dynamic imports, runtime module loaders, Object/Reflect/constructor derivation, indirect or reflective global capability access, unexpected bare packages or Node builtins, unresolved and out-of-root paths, permits only the extractor feature ingress, and retains all preflight and protected-boundary isolation guarantees.
Rollout and rollback are documented in rollout-runbook.md.

tasks.title: Obtain the future checkpoint and registry trust decision
acceptanceCriteria: Only independently verifiable immutable Board approval after security review can select the strategic baseline.

A separate proposal and implementation cover trust anchor, predecessor-authorized rotation, durable replay and revocation state, checkpoint authority, registry ownership, signing/custody, privacy, permissions, tests, rollout, and rollback.
No checkpoint or registry evidence can authorize or enable execution.
